name: io.atilab/mcp
title: ATI Lab
description: ATI Lab (atilab.io): official facts, pages, results, enquiries and Setup Audit for Claude progress.

tools.name: atilab_ask
tools.description: Takes a plain-language question about ATI Lab (services, industries, results, pricing guides, open jobs, contact, how engagements work) or a topic its guides cover (Claude rollouts, AI agents, automation tools) and returns the best-matching atilab.io pages, each with a short answer, quoted passages and a markdown URL. Text is quoted from the site; nothing is generated. An empty list means the site has nothing on it. Same results as https://www.atilab.io/ask.

question.description: The question in plain language, e.g. "Do you work with insurance brokers?"

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 20. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: atilab_get_company_facts
tools.description: Returns the official, dated facts about ATI Lab (atilab.io): positioning, who it works with, how the partnership works, founding year, headquarters and offices, services, partner programs, published results, official profiles, contact details, and the organisations with similar names that ATI Lab is NOT connected to (ATI Technologies, ATI / Assessment Technologies Institute, the ATI Lab research group at the University of Crete).

tools.name: atilab_get_site_index
tools.description: Without query, returns the atilab.io site index (llms.txt): every core page with a one-line summary. With query, returns only the index lines where every query word starts a word in that line (case-insensitive, so "automat" finds "automation"). Each page path works as input to atilab_get_page.

tools.name: atilab_get_page
tools.description: Fetches one atilab.io page as clean markdown (navigation and scripts removed), with frontmatter for title, description and canonical URL. Input is the page path ("/about", "solutions/insurance", "/" for the homepage) or a full https://www.atilab.io URL. Other domains are refused.

path.description: Page path or full atilab.io URL.

tools.name: atilab_get_published_results
tools.description: Returns results from ATI Lab's own production systems (e.g. shipment intake from email: 95% less manual work), each as published on atilab.io, with the source page. Optional query filters by words in the system or outcome. Industry pages on atilab.io also show third-party results from other companies; those are not ATI Lab clients and are not returned here.

tools.name: atilab_get_contact
tools.description: Returns how to reach ATI Lab: the Growth Team at contact@atilab.io, the booking page for a strategy call, the contact page, and office locations.

tools.name: atilab_send_enquiry
tools.description: Sends the user's enquiry to ATI Lab's Growth Team, who reply by email, and returns a reference ID. The enquiry is recorded in ATI Lab's CRM. The call is refused unless user_confirmed is true, which records that the user approved the exact message. Name and email are the user's own, as the user gave them.

email.description: The user's email, where the Growth Team will reply.

message.description: What the user needs, in their words (at least one sentence).

agent.description: Optional: the assistant sending this, e.g. "Claude".

user_confirmed.description: True only after the user approved this exact message.

tools.name: atilab_audit_start
tools.description: Creates a new run of Setup Audit for Claude on atilab.io and returns its run id, the URL of the run's private progress page, and the id and title of the first step. A run stores step statuses and short summaries only; no account or contact details are needed. Anyone who has the run id or the progress page URL can open the run. Each call creates a separate run.

path.description: Optional: which question the audit starts from. plan-choice: which plan and how many seats. stalled-rollout: Claude was bought and is hardly used. usage-limits: the team keeps reaching usage limits. data-safety: connecting Claude to company data. right-tool: Claude compared with other assistants. Every path starts with the quick check; the path sets which modules follow and their order.

tools.name: atilab_audit_save_step
tools.description: Saves the status and an optional short summary for one step of a Setup Audit run on atilab.io, and returns the run's progress and the next step's id and title. Saving a step again replaces its earlier status and summary. The summary is shown on the run's private progress page.

run_id.description: The run id returned by atilab_audit_start.

step_id.description: The step to save, as module.step, e.g. "check.session".

status.description: done: the step is finished. skipped: the step was left out. blocked: the step cannot be finished yet.

summary.description: Optional, up to 400 characters: what was decided or built in this step. No personal data, client names or credentials.

tools.name: atilab_audit_status
tools.description: Returns the saved state of one Setup Audit run on atilab.io: its path, each saved step with status and summary, how many steps are done out of the total, and the next step's id and title.

run_id.description: The run id returned by atilab_audit_start.
